description: Searches every claim Context Pill has published (the ledger). The query takes 1 to 3 key words, such as a product or model name: every word must appear somewhere in a claim, so long queries often miss ('claude spreadsheet' works, a full sentence usually returns 0). Returns status at publication, how it was checked, current state (pending, resolved, corrected or closed-inconclusive), re-check outcome and any correction. Removed items keep only an id, date and reason, so they don't match. Zero matches says nothing about whether a claim is true. Fits questions about an AI launch, feature, price change, benchmark, leak or rumor, or whether something has shipped.

limit.description: Number of claims to return, 1 to 30. Default 10.

query.description: 1 to 3 key words, such as a product or model name, for example 'claude spreadsheet'. Case-insensitive. Every word must appear, so don't pass a full sentence.

name: search_claims
title: Search every published claim
